title: UnecePaymentBalanceOut
description: Offset information to ensure that debits and credits are equal for a transaction.

calculatedAmount.description: A monetary value calculated for this payment balance out.

description.description: A textual description of this payment balance out.

identifier.description: The identifier for this payment balance out.

occurrenceDateTime.description: The date, time, date time, or other date time value of an occurrence of this payment balance out.

reasonCode.description: The code specifying the reason for this payment balance out.

reasonDescription.description: A textual description of the reason for this payment balance out.
